project_name.justification: The text states: "VR Resources Ltd. (TSX.V: VRR, FSE: 5VR; OTCBB: VRRCF), the "Company", or “VR”, is pleased to announce the acquisition of the Rambler Gold Project (“Rambler”)."

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as "VR Resources Ltd. (TSX.V: VRR, FSE: 5VR; OTCBB: VRRCF)".

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO is identified in the text: "From VR’s CEO Justin Daley..." and in the signature block: "“Justin Daley” Justin Daley, MSc, PGeo President & CEO".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The project was acquired via staking ("Rambler was staked because sulfides reported in historic drill logs have been discovered at surface"), which implies 100% interest, but no specific percentage is mentioned in the text.

primary_commodity.justification: The project is explicitly named the "Rambler Gold Project" in the headline and text body.

verified_article_link.justification: No article link was provided in the source documents.

currency.justification: The project was acquired by staking, and no financial transaction involving a currency is mentioned.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The project was acquired by staking, not by a cash purchase. No cash payment is mentioned in the text.

share_payments_raw.justification: The project was acquired by staking, not by a share-based purchase. No share payment is mentioned in the text.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The project was acquired by staking, and no combined cash and share payment is mentioned.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: No shares were issued as part of the acquisition, which was done by staking.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned as part of the acquisition.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the acquisition.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the acquisition, so there is no associated share price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text mentions a permit application for drilling but does not specify a committed meterage.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The text mentions a general requirement for exploration expenditures to maintain the claim ("the Province requires certain annual exploration expenditures and reporting") but does not state a specific committed value.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: There is no mention of a Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) or any other royalty in the text.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text states: "The Project consists of 4 multi-cell mineral claims in 1 contiguous block spanning 6.5 by 5.5 km and covering 2,085 hectares."

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text states: "The Project consists of 4 multi-cell mineral claims in 1 contiguous block spanning 6.5 by 5.5 km and covering 2,085 hectares."

resource_size.justification: The text describes historical drilling intercepts and gold potential but does not contain a quantified mineral resource estimate with mass or volume (e.g., tonnes, ounces).

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The text identifies the company and its ticker as "VR Resources Ltd. (TSX.V: VRR, FSE: 5VR; OTCBB: VRRCF)". TSX.V corresponds to the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV).
